balance.instructions: Which validation design best prevents a generated class from exceeding shared power limits while preserving free class identity?

criteria.aggregate_budget: A versioned level-dependent stat point budget and aggregate skill score including damage, healing, shields, conditions, area target caps, range and uptime; reject excess before publication.
criteria.individual_caps: Only cap each attribute and effect independently, allowing many individually legal strengths to stack without an overall limit.
criteria.prompt_only: Ask the model to be balanced but accept every schema-valid result.

themes.instructions: How should fantasy, apocalypse and survival themes affect a persistent tactical campaign?

criteria.content_packs: Distinct terrain images, palette, locations, story hooks, NPC/enemy labels and sample classes, while sharing the same local rules and balance budgets.
criteria.palette_only: Change colors and preserve the fantasy story and character names in every theme.
criteria.separate_engines: Build three separate combat engines with unrelated state formats.
